WITH filtered_date_dim AS (
    SELECT d_date_sk
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE d_year = 2000
),
customer_total_return AS (
    SELECT
        wr.wr_returning_customer_sk AS ctr_customer_sk,
        ca.ca_state AS ctr_state,
        SUM(wr.wr_return_amt) AS ctr_total_return
    FROM web_returns wr
    JOIN filtered_date_dim dd ON wr.wr_returned_date_sk = dd.d_date_sk
    JOIN customer_address ca ON wr.wr_returning_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
    GROUP BY wr.wr_returning_customer_sk, ca.ca_state
),
state_avg AS (
    SELECT
        ctr_state,
        AVG(ctr_total_return) * 1.2 AS avg_state_total_return
    FROM customer_total_return
    GROUP BY ctr_state
)
SELECT
    c.c_customer_id,
    c.c_salutation,
    c.c_first_name,
    c.c_last_name,
    c.c_preferred_cust_flag,
    c.c_birth_day,
    c.c_birth_month,
    c.c_birth_year,
    c.c_birth_country,
    c.c_login,
    c.c_email_address,
    c.c_last_review_date_sk,
    ctr1.ctr_total_return
FROM customer_total_return ctr1
JOIN state_avg sa ON ctr1.ctr_state = sa.ctr_state
    AND ctr1.ctr_total_return > sa.avg_state_total_return
JOIN customer c ON ctr1.ctr_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
JOIN customer_address curr_addr ON curr_addr.ca_address_sk = c.c_current_addr_sk
    AND curr_addr.ca_state = 'AR'
ORDER BY
    c.c_customer_id,
    c.c_salutation,
    c.c_first_name,
    c.c_last_name,
    c.c_preferred_cust_flag,
    c.c_birth_day,
    c.c_birth_month,
    c.c_birth_year,
    c.c_birth_country,
    c.c_login,
    c.c_email_address,
    c.c_last_review_date_sk,
    ctr1.ctr_total_return
LIMIT 100
